title: Keep signed-candidate metadata diagnostics independent of Git display settings
outcome: The remote test adapter reads true candidate tree/parent metadata without signature-display text and explains unsupported or malformed object identities separately from parent-count refusals.
acceptance: With log.showSignature enabled, a valid signed single-parent candidate is parsed without a false parent-count refusal; malformed or unsupported tree/commit identity gets a reason naming that check, before publication.
